intro: The Mystic is Guildrun's Mana Regen class: support casters that repeatedly fire active abilities to shield allies and disrupt enemies. Mystics scale Mana Regen and lean on Shields, Shards, Debuffs, and Stall — the more casts they get, the more the whole board benefits. In Demo 0.5.3 they are the glue that stabilizes messy mid-run boards and turns long fights into wins. Draft a Mystic when you keep seeing Mana Regen and Shield banners or need attrition tools against durable enemy packs.
seoDescription: Guildrun Mystic class guide: Mana Regen support casters with Shields and Debuffs. Best Mystic heroes, relics, and how to stabilize your board.
roleLabel: Mana Regen support caster — Shields / Debuffs / Stall
strength: Repeatable casts: high Mana Regen means constant shields, debuffs, and utility for the whole team
weakness: Low native burst — starved of Mana Regen or opened on by dive, a Mystic contributes little

howToPlay.draft: Take a Mystic to stabilize, not to solo-clear. Secure cast-loop Mystics early, Rank B toward economy or team shields, and add a real front-liner so the support engine has something to protect.
howToPlay.shop: Mana Regen and Max Mana first — they are both uptime and coverage. Then Shield and Stall payoffs. Raw Magic on a Mystic is a trap before cast uptime is solved.
howToPlay.positioning: Back or second row behind the tankiest body. Never leave a Mystic alone on a dive tile — a dead caster stops the whole loop.

shopPriorities: Mana Regen and Max Mana to fix cast uptime first
Mystic Shield / Barrier banners for team peel
A borrowed front-liner or defensive item so the Mystic survives

faq.question: What is the Mystic class in Guildrun?
faq.answer: Mystics are a Mana Regen class of support casters that repeatedly use active abilities to shield allies and disrupt enemies, scaling Shields, Shards, Debuffs, and Stall. More casts mean more team value.

faq.question: What are the best Mystic heroes in Guildrun?
faq.answer: Grace (shields, heals, resurrection), Pollen (Poison/shield field), Fiona (economy cast-loop), and Gustav (shield zone) are the top Mystic picks for stabilizing a board.

faq.question: What relics work with Mystics?
faq.answer: Mana Regen and Max Mana first for cast uptime, then Mystic Shield/Barrier banners and Stall enablers for cast-after-Stall payoffs. Solve uptime before stacking raw Magic.

faq.question: Are Mystics good on their own?
faq.answer: No — Mystics are a support core, not a full clear squad. Pair them with a real carry and a front line; they win attrition fights but lack native burst.

tips: If casts are rare, fix Mana Regen / Max Mana before buying more shield amulets.
A Mystic core needs borrowed damage from a carry, items, or events — don't expect it to solo Act 1.
